title: bongbong room servers
description: The online co-op room servers: production and every PR preview. Provisioned from k8s/base/grafana/bongbong-rooms.json - edit it there, not in the UI.

list.name: Server starts
list.expr: max by (pod, version, protocol) (bongbong_info{namespace="$namespace"}) unless max by (pod, version, protocol) (bongbong_info{namespace="$namespace"} offset 1m)

panels.title: Servers
panels.description: One row per namespace that runs a room server: production (bongbong-prod) and every open PR's preview (bongbong-pr-N). Pick one in the namespace selector above to see it in detail below.

targets.expr: max by (namespace, tag, protocol) (label_replace(kube_pod_container_info{container="rooms", namespace=~"bongbong-.*"}, "tag", "$1", "image", ".*:([^:]+)$") * on (namespace, pod) group_left (protocol) max by (namespace, pod, protocol) (bongbong_info{namespace=~"bongbong-.*"}))

panels.title: Scrape
panels.description: Is Prometheus reaching /metrics on this server right now?

panels.title: Build
panels.description: The image tag the pod runs and its net::PROTOCOL_VERSION. A client refuses a server on another protocol by name.

targets.expr: max by (namespace, tag, protocol) (label_replace(kube_pod_container_info{container="rooms", namespace="$namespace"}, "tag", "$1", "image", ".*:([^:]+)$") * on (namespace, pod) group_left (protocol) max by (namespace, pod, protocol) (bongbong_info{namespace="$namespace"}))

panels.title: State
panels.description: Draining: SIGTERM received - no new rooms or rematches, waiting for the rounds in play to end (up to 30 min in production).

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since the room server's container started.

panels.title: In play
panels.description: Rooms whose round is ticking at 60 Hz.

panels.title: Online
panels.description: Players with somebody on the socket, in every room.

panels.title: Tick p99
panels.description: 99th percentile of Game::update wall time over the last ~1024 ticks. The budget is one tick, 16.7 ms: orange from half of it, red from 80 %.

panels.title: Restarts
panels.description: Container restarts in the last 24 hours - a crash, an OOM kill or a failed liveness check.

panels.title: Rooms by phase
panels.description: Stacked, so the top edge is every room the server holds; the red line is --max-rooms, past which new rooms are refused. waiting: a lobby. playing: ticking. paused: nobody connected. ended: the end screen before a rematch.

panels.title: Players
panels.description: Seats by connection state, stacked. away: the seat is owned but its socket dropped - it is held for the grace period and reclaimed by the same device token.

panels.title: Arrivals per hour
panels.description: New WebSocket connections, seats reclaimed by a reconnect, and rooms created, each counted per hour.

panels.title: Rooms in play now, by map
panels.description: Rooms playing a round right now, by map and mission. custom is a map a player built rather than a shipped one.

panels.title: Rounds started, by map
panels.description: Rounds started over the dashboard's time range, by map.

panels.title: Rounds started, by mission
panels.description: Rounds started over the dashboard's time range, by mission.

panels.title: Rounds won, by mission
panels.description: The share of the rounds that ended over the dashboard's time range that the players won, by mission. Rounds a room stopped before either side won are left out.

targets.expr: sum by (mission) (increase(bongbong_rounds_ended_total{outcome="won", namespace="$namespace", job="rooms"}[$__range])) / sum by (mission) (increase(bongbong_rounds_ended_total{outcome=~"won|lost", namespace="$namespace", job="rooms"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Rounds started per hour
panels.description: Rounds started each hour on this server, every map and mission together.

panels.title: Client builds
panels.description: Every client build that asked this server for a room: its version, the protocol it speaks and its platform, how many are connected now and how many seats they took over the dashboard's time range. unknown is a build too old to say. Past 32 builds, the rest count as other.

panels.title: On another protocol
panels.description: Connected clients that speak a protocol other than this server's (bongbong_info). Such a client is welcomed and then leaves, so any here are players who cannot play until they update.

targets.expr: sum(bongbong_clients{protocol!~"unknown|other", namespace="$namespace", job="rooms"} unless on (protocol) max by (protocol) (bongbong_info{namespace="$namespace", job="rooms"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Players by platform
panels.description: Connections that asked for a room, open right now, by the platform their client runs on.

panels.title: Tick time
panels.description: Game::update wall time, p50 and p99 over the last ~1024 ticks across every room. The red line is one tick (16.7 ms): an update past it is an overrun, and every room on the server stutters together.

panels.title: Tick lateness
panels.description: How late each tick started against the room's schedule (net::authority::TickClock), p50 and p99. The red line is 5 ms, past which a tick counts as late. Exported by servers newer than protocol 6.

panels.title: Tick rate
panels.description: Game::update calls per second across the server, against 60 per room playing. A gap between the two is time the rooms lost.

panels.title: Tick trouble per minute
panels.description: overruns: an update longer than a tick. late: a tick that started more than 5 ms after it was due. dropped: ticks a room gave up on after a stall longer than its catch-up. Late and dropped are exported by servers newer than protocol 6.

panels.title: Snapshot bandwidth
panels.description: Snapshot bytes handed to the seats' writers, per second - the game's own outgoing traffic, before WebSocket framing and TLS.

panels.title: Snapshot bytes per player
panels.description: Snapshot bandwidth divided by the players connected: what one client downloads per second. Empty while nobody is connected.

panels.title: Snapshots skipped per minute
panels.description: Snapshots a slow client did not get because its outbox was full. A steady climb is a player on a link that cannot keep up.

panels.title: Input starvations per minute
panels.description: Ticks that found a seat's intent buffer empty and repeated its last intent. For a client-owned hull each one is a packet late enough that the room dead-reckoned the tank.

panels.title: Starved ticks per connected player
panels.description: Input starvations as a share of every seat's ticks (60 a second per connected player): the fraction of the time the room was guessing a player's input.

panels.title: CPU (log scale)
panels.description: Millicores the room server uses (1000 mCPU = one core), against its request, on a log axis so an idle server and the request both read. There is deliberately no CPU limit: a CFS quota would throttle the 60 Hz tick at the period boundary.

panels.title: Memory (log scale)
panels.description: Working set against the request and the limit, on a log axis so a few MiB and the limit both read. Past the limit the container is OOM-killed and every room on it is lost.

panels.title: Pod network
panels.description: Bytes per second through the pod's interface: WebSocket traffic including framing, plus the scrapes.
